column3: Re-derives proofs/libreac/fuzz_disco/lib/Reusable/YB05.v (the image B start-up plan) and remap.B.tsv from the released donor files proofs/cgif/cgif_file_fuzzer/lib/YB05.v, YB1k.v and YF0m.v and the two image B pins (each checked against its index/binaries.tsv row): address map, address step, tail, ranges, module paths; the Modified note is read from line 4 of the shipped YB05.v. Then compares remap.B.tsv and YB05.v byte for byte, and shows that proofs/libreac/fuzz_disco/lib/Reusable/YB1k.v is the address step's output with the unit's module paths and one value set by hand (line 66, F_020 0x65000 -> 0x65afc, the review row of remap.B.tsv).

Aligns two builds of the same RISC-V program and writes the old -> new address map (code runs, data anchors, TLS layout) that numeral_map.py reads; run.sh runs it on the donor's image B and the unit's image B. New version of the kit's address-map tool (kit copy sha256 4d51ec1c0069) under this neutral name: the map's tool tag is renamed to match and three comment lines are reworded, no other change. Its map equals the map of the run of record except the two image paths and that tag. Same bytes as core-Y/kit/elf_symbols.py.

Classifies every address-like number of Rocq files against the old image and moves it through the address map; writes the per-value report remap.B.tsv and the rewritten donor YB05.v, YB1k.v and YF0m.v. New version of the kit's address-moving tool (kit copy sha256 2d846496640d) under this neutral name: the map tool tag it accepts, and the comments and help texts that named the two kit tools by their old file names or named a port, are reworded; no other change. Same bytes as core-Y/kit/numeral_map.py.

Module both kit tools import: a stdlib ELF64 reader and the RV64GC decoder (instruction lengths, PC-relative and auipc-paired immediates). Kit copy sha256 23152d9ca11c with line 1 naming the two tools by their new names.py. Same bytes as core-Y/kit/rvelf.py.

Puts the plan's tail into every arm; run.sh uses its insert subcommand only: 46 PX XMemset / PRun pairs before each final PRun [main] (main 0x80b1c on image B, 46 the count the collector's probe measured). Start-up tool set 2026-10-29 copy sha256 f8aa639d5cc7 with nine docstring lines and the header comments of its two probe templates reworded; no code changed.

Recomputes the plan's startup_plan_tfib_ranges for image B: with --rule text, one range per executable section of the image, here [(0x30f24, 112841)] (.text, counted in four-byte instruction words). Frozen copy sha256 563d9c175a38 with five docstring lines reworded and its helper directory renamed to trlen/; no other change.

Module itabranges.py imports for --rule text: the capstone RISC-V 64 + C decoder it uses to refuse an image with compressed or misaligned instructions. Copy sha256 acc3b31392a5 with its docstring reworded.

Rewrites the donor module paths to the unit's and adds the one Modified line; turns the finished plan into the shipped proofs/libreac/fuzz_disco/lib/Reusable/YB05.v. Same bytes as collector/tools/to_disco.py.

numeral_map.py's per-value report of the one address-step call over the donor's YB05.v, YB1k.v and YF0m.v (764 rows: file, line, column, literal, class, status, new value, note); run.sh regenerates it byte for byte. YB05.v: 273 mapped, 13 review, all 13 on the ranges line that itabranges.py replaces. YB1k.v: 55 mapped, 13 review, 4 decode-check-needed; its row at line 66 column 47 records the .text value 0x65000 as review with the mapped value 0x65afc (a page-aligned value whose mapped value is not page-aligned), the value the shipped YB1k.v takes for F_020 by hand. YF0m.v: 268 mapped, 54 review, 81 ambiguous, 2 unmappable, for proofs/libreac/fuzz_disco/lib/Reusable/YF0m.v, which core-Y covers.
